notes: Coordinator › Sections › Schedule: a class can be set on several days at once. Tick every day it meets (for example Mon, Wed and Fri) and give the time, subject and teacher once.
Bulk enrollment reads each line as LRN, SURNAME, First Name M.I., M/F, Track/Strand (for example: 136412345678, DIN, Christian Aurbee B., M, Academic - GAS). Lines copied from a spreadsheet work too.
Learners enrolled in Manila City Jail classes have no app account. Accounts made for them before are removed when the coordinator's app updates; they stay enrolled.
The loading screen stays as it should until the app opens: no more moment of large logos over plain text.
Coordinator's Enrollment tab: each learner's photo leads the card at the same size as in Accounts, and the Male/Female headings of the tally no longer run together at the larger text size.
The class leaderboard is on every class, including the advisory class. A class where nobody has handed anything in yet says so instead of hiding the board.

Learners now see the whole class on the leaderboard, in subject classes and in the advisory class. The teacher's or adviser's app keeps each board up to date as work comes in, without having to open the class.
The leaderboard title no longer sits on the card's border.
The sign-in page shows the app's version.
RLP (progress) counts the work a learner has handed in and the work that was graded, with the number handed in, graded and the average for each subject.
School Form 1 (SF1) has room for 50 male and 50 female learners, prints all columns on each page, and every name has its full box.
Coordinator's Home: Meetings with learners no longer has its heading twice. Fingerprint sign-in is removed.
notes_fil: Coordinator › Sections › Schedule: maaaring itakda ang isang klase sa ilang araw nang sabay. Pindutin ang bawat araw na may klase (halimbawa Lun, Miy at Biy) at ilagay nang isang beses ang oras, asignatura at guro.

Binabasa ng bulk enrollment ang bawat linya bilang LRN, APELYIDO, Pangalan M.I., M/F, Track/Strand (halimbawa: 136412345678, DIN, Christian Aurbee B., M, Academic - GAS). Gumagana rin ang mga linyang kinopya mula sa spreadsheet.

Walang account sa app ang mga mag-aaral na naka-enroll sa klase sa Manila City Jail. Inaalis ang mga account na nagawa para sa kanila dati kapag na-update ang app ng coordinator; naka-enroll pa rin sila.
Nananatiling maayos ang loading screen hanggang bumukas ang app: wala nang sandaling malalaking logo sa ibabaw ng payak na teksto.

Tab na Enrollment ng coordinator: nauuna na ang litrato ng bawat mag-aaral sa card sa parehong laki ng nasa Accounts, at hindi na nagdidikit ang LALAKI at BABAE sa tally sa mas malaking laki ng teksto.
Nasa bawat klase na ang class leaderboard, kasama ang advisory class. Kapag wala pang nakapagpasa, sinasabi ito sa halip na itago ang board.

Nakikita na ng mga mag-aaral ang buong klase sa leaderboard, sa mga asignatura at sa advisory class. Ang app ng guro o adviser ang nag-a-update ng bawat board habang may nagpapasa, kahit hindi binubuksan ang klase.
Hindi na nakapatong sa gilid ng card ang pamagat ng leaderboard.
Makikita na ang bersiyon ng app sa sign-in page.
Binibilang na ng RLP (progress) ang mga naipasa at namarkahang gawain ng mag-aaral, kasama ang bilang ng naipasa, namarkahan at ang average sa bawat asignatura.
May puwang na ang School Form 1 (SF1) para sa 50 lalaki at 50 babae, nakalimbag ang lahat ng hanay sa bawat pahina, at may sariling kahon ang bawat pangalan.
Home ng coordinator: hindi na doble ang pamagat ng Meetings with learners. Inalis na ang fingerprint sign-in.
